column6: 冰块在篝火上融化,滤去尘沙即得饮用水。
column7: Ice melts over the campfire; filter out the dust and it is drinking water.

column6: 灌丛生物质压实成营养块。难吃,但活着。
column7: Shrub biomass pressed into a nutrient block. Tastes awful, keeps you alive.

column6: 撕开干燥灌丛,理出坚韧的植物纤维。
column7: Dry shrubs torn and combed into tough plant fiber.

column6: 铁矿石在篝火中粗炼成海绵铁块,够打小件。
column7: Iron ore roughly bloomed over the campfire; enough for small fittings.

column6: 铜矿石低温还原出粗铜块,导电导热都还行。
column7: Copper ore reduced to a crude lump; it conducts well enough.

column6: 石英砂烧结成浑浊的粗玻璃,透光就行。
column7: Quartz sand sintered into cloudy glass. It lets light through, and that is enough.

column6: 石墨矿手工碾成碳粉,燃料与滤料两用。
column7: Graphite ground by hand into carbon powder: fuel and filter medium in one.

column6: 盐矿敲碎淘洗,结晶出可食用的盐。
column7: Salt ore crushed and washed; edible salt crystallizes out.

column6: 口粮腌渍脱水,顶得住风暴天的储备。
column7: Rations salted and dried into storm-proof reserves.

column6: 纤维织成急救绷带,关键时刻能救一条命。
column7: Fiber woven into a first-aid bandage. It buys a life some time.

column6: 多层纤维絮成保温衬垫,睡舱的必需品。
column7: Layered fiber batting for insulation; sleep pods need it.

column6: 铁块加纤维柄,凑合能用的工具。
column7: An iron head on a fiber-wrapped grip. Crude, but it works.
